title: Joe Burrow on lack of offensive balance: My response is "throw it more"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Burrow on lack of offensive balance: My response is "throw it more"
sources.description: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow dropped back to pass 58 times on unpenalized plays in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jaguars, but he isn't looking for more offensive balance in the coming weeks.
